meta.name: create-image-fal
meta.description: Generate or edit an image via any FAL image model (nano-banana edit, gpt-image, flux, ...), ROUTED THROUGH THE fal-proxy so it bills the Ads agent. image_urls must be public URLs (orchestrator hosts local product refs via MCP upload->presign). The recipe names the model + prompt. Use for keyframes, flat-cover transforms, product hero edits. (For the OpenAI gpt-image family specifically, create-image-gpt-image-fal also exists.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用任意 FAL 图像模型生成或编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过 FAL 模型生成或编辑产品图片、关键帧或封面。
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images via any FAL image model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or edit product images, keyframes, or covers using FAL models.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 FAL 的多种图像模型（如 nano-banana edit、gpt-image、flux 等）生成或编辑图片，并返回图片链接。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑图片，且指定使用 FAL 模型时触发。

say.text: 用 nano-banana edit 把这张产品图背景换成白色。
say.note: Claude 会调用该模型编辑图片。

say.text: 用 flux 生成一张赛博朋克风格的城市夜景。
say.note: Claude 会调用 flux 模型生成图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or edit images via any FAL image model (e.g., nano-banana edit, gpt-image, flux) and return the image URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate or edit an image using a FAL model.

say_en.text: Use nano-banana edit to change the product image background to white.
say_en.note: Claude will call the model to edit the image.

say_en.text: Use flux to generate a cyberpunk city night view.
say_en.note: Claude will call the flux model to generate the image.
